body:
Closes #392

A 1.8.9 neo capture that is only feasible through a single-tick X inertia zeroing (vX dips to 0.00498 < 0.005 mid-flight, the clip shifts landing X by ~0.026) failed 0/5 in ~70 ms at both efforts, with the 21 s Optimize budget untouched. The no-zeroing relaxation is truly infeasible by ~2e-3 blocks (the diverging dual is a valid certificate, cross-checked with an independent 200k-candidate wall search), and no stage could represent the zeroing: the closed form's inertia passes derive their pattern from a pass-0 result that an unbounded dual never produces, SLP seeds from that same diverged recovery, and the pattern B&B both refused the spec outright at `hasFacingWall` (the dF=0 constraint compiles to F-mode walls) and enumerated only suffix zeroings, which cannot express a one-tick zeroing followed by re-acceleration.

The fix, confined to `BoundPrunedRecovery` plus one catalog default:

- The facing-wall gate refuses only specs `FacingPrefold.analyze` cannot fold, so dF=0 pins reach the rescue. Bounds stay position-only (the pinned tick is treated as free), which is loose but sound; every candidate is still gated by the compiled byte-exact check including the F walls. dF inequalities keep the old refusal (`gh313-j121-dfneo` stays accepted-fail).
- `enumeratePatterns` emits single-tick masks `zx1@k`/`zz1@k` (`zxz1@k` for radial-inertia versions) alongside the suffixes; the linear model and `velocityWalls` already handle arbitrary masks, only the generator changed (`addPattern` grew an `end` parameter; `k == n-1` is skipped as a duplicate of the suffix).
- `maxPatterns` default 8 -> 64 in `Config` and the `NodeCatalog` ParamSpec. The 8 was an untuned constant from #209, copied verbatim by #228, overridden by no preset; 64 covers all mask families to n~17 outright, and far beyond in hard cases where most masks die at the root-bound triage.
- Witness capture pinned as `problems/solve/inertia-1tick-neo` (FAST, 20 s budget).

Verification:

- The capture solves at FAST, 5/5 met in ~130 ms cold (27 ms in-suite), chain "closed form -> pattern B&B (first feasible)", dF held exactly. Root-bound triage kills the free pattern and every suffix, leaving four `zx1@` candidates; the banded-incumbent lane solves `zx1@4` byte-exact through the prefold-aware closed form, so the tree search never runs. The found objective (X 8086.29633, MIN) beats the hand-found trajectory in the capture (8086.29904).
- `gh313-j121-dfneo` remains accepted-fail (dF-inequality corridors are too wide to pin, `analyze` still refuses).
- `:core:test -PslowTests` green in 2 m 48 s, including the new pin; no existing capture changed outcome or budget.

**Addendum (in-game QA finding, fixed in-session):** starting the window ON the zeroing tick itself still failed (UI t31 on this capture: the seed vX is 0.00498, below the threshold). A sub-threshold seed velocity is dead on arrival in the game (the exact model cancels it at the top of the first tick before any read), but every linear relaxation carried it as a constant, and the `k >= 1` pattern space cannot represent a tick-0 zeroing; correctly so, since there are no prior inputs to wall (it is a constant fact of the scenario, not a solver choice). Fix: `ExactJumpModel.zeroSubThresholdVelocity` mirrors the model's own tick-top cancellation (per-axis and combined eras, same constants including the combined `9.0E-6` literal, so it is version-correct for every `forMcVersion` instance), and `buildPhys` normalizes the seed velocity through it at the single point where the seed enters the scenario; byte-exact identical for the exact model by construction, and it fixes closed form, SLP, and the B&B bounds at once. The previously failing window now solves via plain closed form (no rescue needed), the neighboring windows are unchanged, and the case is pinned as `problems/solve/inertia-1tick-neo-t31` (same capture, `startTick` 30, seed advanced to the tick-30 state). `:core:test -PslowTests` green in 2 m 46 s.
title: fix(solver): reach single-tick inertia zeroings in the pattern B&B
